verdict.rationale: Graphite documents org-wide rollout of its AI reviews: they can be enabled for the entire organization or for selected repositories, which gives some central repo-level exception handling. Teams can also define custom rules and comment exclusions for the review agent. This covers only AI-review defaults, and the scope at which rules apply (org vs. repo) is not documented. Missing for 10: org-level defaults for human review settings (reviewers, approvals, merge rules), a documented central exceptions/override mechanism beyond repo selection, evidence that customizations apply org-wide, and hands-on corroboration at hundreds-of-repos scale.
